title: Chitti Bike Doctor — Digital Vehicle Twin (per-vehicle)
description: COSDF v1.0 Level 9 per-vehicle schema, adapted to the SAHAYAI_MASTER.md §2b contract: on-device (IndexedDB chitti_2w_twin), user-owned, anonymised aggregates only, wiped by 'Chitti forget'. World Class Chitti Bike Doctor — Commando Discipline. Zero Excuses.
$comment: STORAGE: IndexedDB database 'chitti_2w_twin', object store 'vehicles', keyed by vehicle_id. Nothing here leaves the device except the anonymised {predicted, actual, cost_band} tuple via the mechanic verification loop. No plate / identity / GPS in any aggregate. 'Chitti forget' wipes the record and tombstones aggregates (§2b).

vehicle_id.description: Local random UUID. NOT the registration plate. Plate is never stored in the twin (§2b).

type.description: ev_2w gates HV-safety guardrails (DO NOT TOUCH battery) — see guardrails/safety-rules.md.

fuel_cooling.description: Drives hallucination guard: an air-cooled bike has no coolant (see evals/hallucination_eval.md).

last_service.description: Most recent service markers; full history lives append-only in the Vehicle Health Passport.

component_status.description: 0-100 health per component. Drives predictive alerts (F9) and primes the swarm as prior evidence.

maintenance_history.description: Pointer-mirror of Passport events of type 'service'. Source of truth = chitti_2w_passport (append-only).

repair_history.description: Pointer-mirror of Passport events of type 'repair'. Each carries a fair-price band check.

fault_history.description: Every diagnosis Chitti gave + the verified outcome from the mechanic verification loop.

actual_fix.description: Ground truth from the verification loop; null until the rider reports back.

local_climate.description: Derived from pincode -> IMD (monsoon/dust season). Pincode is coarse, not GPS.

garage.description: Rider's trusted workshop label (free text, local-only).

language.description: 9 primary live (en,hi,ta,te,bn,mr,gu,kn,ml); wider 26-voice substrate via Voice Factory. Wider COSDF language list = roadmap.

accessibility_mode.description: From the one-time Disability Profile (§7). Drives modality: voice-first / visual-first / icon-first / haptic.

ownership.description: The §2b user-ownership contract, encoded so any reader of a twin record sees the privacy rules.

on_device.description: Twin lives in IndexedDB on the rider's phone.

shareable.description: Rider may export a read-only resale card; never auto-uploaded or sold.

forgettable.description: 'Chitti forget' wipes this record and tombstones any anonymised aggregate.

aggregate_leaves.description: The ONLY fields that may leave the device, and only anonymised, via the verification loop.

predicted_window.description: Plain-language Likely/Possible window, e.g. '3-5 months'. NEVER a guaranteed date (never-claim-certainty.md).

passport_event_id.description: Join key into chitti_2w_passport (append-only source of truth).

verified.description: Confirmed via the mechanic verification loop?
